text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOAGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Oh no—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (It's so hot...!! It hurts so much...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (It's so much fun...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... —

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—All right!
I gave it everything I had right now...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Besides—it feels like a fire's been lit inside my chest,
and it's still burning hot even now...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (So this is what a real race is like...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (The place I yearned for back then—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(That scenery everyone called "another world."
Right now, I'm standing right on the edge of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove it from here on out...!
That there's no such thing as a 'different world'...!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Well, about as expected!
Yep, yep! Great job~!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Even though this was finally my debut race...
Running like this... I'm just...—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Next time, we're going for the win...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (――I need to make sure I remember the faces of everyone who ran with me today.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And... I'm going to walk my own path!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after her debut race. As we discussed our future plans with Katsuragi Ace, I decided to share my thoughts—
choice_data_list: For your junior year, let's prioritize building up your fundamentals

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So rather than entering races,
you want to focus on training... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. Presenting the documents, I outlined
a plan focused primarily on conditioning, entering races
that would build a track record leading to the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...There was the option of aggressively entering races during the Junior Class aiming for graded stakes victories, but――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She aims to become the "Ace" of the Umamusume world.
It would be wise to set our sights on the highest stage early on and move toward it without wasted effort.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The pinnacle stage... Does that mean—
choice_data_list: —We're taking the Classic Triple Crown route.
—We're going for the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Classic Triple Crown route.
A glorious arena where the strongest of their generation compete across three GⅠ races: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a supreme battlefield where only the chosen Umamusume gather—
yet there is no reason for Katsuragi Ace and myself
to fear it as 'another world' and not strive for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything—I believe it is a stage she must reach
if Katsuragi Ace is to truly become the "Ace"
of the Umamusume world...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —So in the Junior Class, both our training and the races we enter will be planned with our sights set on the Triple Crown path, right?
choice_data_list: Think of it as a knight-errant training journey.
Think of it as a training journey, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nice. Sounds fiery...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Classic Triple Crown route is easy enough to say,
but to actually get there, one must pass through
an extremely narrow gate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a world where just becoming a "winning Umamusume"
is difficult enough, one must demonstrate truly
exceptional skill and achievements above all others.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...I know. But I'm happy, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Believing that I can aim for "that place"—
and that you'll aim for it right beside me—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It's because you believe in me and tell me that!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's do it, our warrior's quest! And I will definitely become one!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A strong Umamusume—capable of challenging
the Classic Triple Crown route!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Displaying their clenched fists like a mirror image,
they reaffirm their path forward and their shared feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our days of rigorous training for the Classic Triple Crown campaign were set in motion...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...What a nice sky.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――It's thrilling, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's a red so deep you feel like you'll be sucked into it.
It makes you want to run... and dive right in.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "CB?! Why are you here—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just told you, didn't I?
It's because the sky makes me want to run.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Come to think of it, Ace, congrats on your debut.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha. What's the matter, Ace?
You've been doing nothing but looking surprised for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, I just never expected you
to bring up my debut race, of all things...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? Even I'm interested
in things related to racing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah~, I wanna run in my debut race soon too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...CB is still a bit further down the road, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I can hardly wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Alright, time for a run.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
Hey, C.B.!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Seriously, you always spring things on me out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha!
I can't wait! My debut race!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(CB is accelerating faster and faster.
As if to leave everything behind――)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You really are amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(You're always like this.
Never bound by rules or common sense, just breaking away from everything so effortlessly—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (She transcends everything I'm fighting for—so easily, and having fun doing it—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (It's precisely because you're that kind of person—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wait uuuup! C.B.!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Good grief...
What are we gonna do about this? We're barely gonna make curfew.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If we run again, it'll be a breeze.
Or are you already completely worn out?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hah—
Bring it on. I can keep running as long as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, now that's the spirit.
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey!
I told you! Don't just start running out of nowhere!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I'll train, run races,
and definitely get stronger in this Junior Class!
And then, I'll catch up to them...!)
